briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, multiple cases of healthcare fraud were uncovered, including a $6.5B nationwide takedown and a $700,000 Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota. Seven Minnesota providers were charged in the Medicaid fraud scheme. Additionally, a $3.7B Medicare fraud scheme was uncovered, and a suspect was caught in Turkey and sent to Florida. These large-scale fraud schemes warrant further investigation into the individuals and organizations involved. The Minnesota Attorney General's office and the DOJ are actively investigating these cases. Next steps include following the money trail and identifying any connections between the individuals and organizations involved.
